sources.title: Braids: A Survey
sources.authors_or_authority: Joan S. Birman, Tara E. Brendle
sources.claim_scope: Braid multiplication by juxtaposition (Sec.1, Fig.1); B_n as pi_1 of the configuration space and the exact sequence 1 -> P_n -> B_n -> Sigma_n -> 1 (Sec.1.1); defining relations (eq.(2)); B_n -> Sigma_n, sigma_i -> (i i+1) (Sec.4.1); unreduced and reduced Burau matrices (Sec.4.2 p.46); F_n = pi_1(D_n, d_0) with x_i counterclockwise about q_i (Sec.4.4); extension 1 -> F_n -> B_{1,n} -> B_n -> 1 and Artin's action eq.(20) (Sec.4.7).
sources.notes: Digest is SHA-256 of the bytes served at https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0409205v2 at retrieved_at. The signs of the reduced Burau block were read from the rendered PDF page 46 (a plain-text extraction drops the minus signs and yields a matrix that is NOT a subquotient of the unreduced representation).
